title: GatewayCatalog
description: The E3 body of PUT /api/v1/gateways/{id}/catalog: the connectors and targets bound in the Gateway's local configuration. Full replace. It carries ids, kinds, display names, intervals and, for Argo CD targets, an identity digest. It never carries a URL, credential, raw uid or secret value.

localId.description: Lowercase DNS label. It cannot hold a URL, path, namespace separator or credential.

identityDigest.description: Scoped identity digest (ADR 0002 condition C3): d- and the first 130 bits of SHA-256("sb-argocd-target/v1" || uint32_be(len(connector_id)) || connector_id || metadata.uid) in lower-case base32. The same value as the evidence resource.identity_digest. One-way and scoped to the connector; the raw uid is never sent.

identity.description: Argo CD targets only. Present once the Gateway knows the Application's uid: from settings at startup, or after the first verified read (the uid check and the per-target can-i probe passed). The control plane pins the first identity it accepts for a target and treats a different one as identity_changed.
